plaatsen.tekst: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.
And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.
And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.
Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.
And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.
And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide
I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people
My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die
And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed
And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save
Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
